coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 12 of 17 ground-truth items (71%): Adam/MSE with early stopping, consistent data splits, all six model-configuration variables, both data-processing variables, and MSE/MAE evaluation.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies CPU-only execution rather than an RTX 4090 GPU. Epoch caps of 100–200 differ from 30, and batch sizes of 32–64 differ from the reference 256. Synthetic-data generation parameters are absent. Visualization coverage is incomplete: training-loss curves are included, but learned cyclic-pattern plots are not. The loss ablation also departs from the fixed-loss control.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected conclusion describing a trained CycleNet forecasting model and visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
